scope: Frozen launcher v3 with worker/contract/journal v2, scoped to inventory source readiness; source and bounded synthetic only

findings_resolved.resolution: Inventory now runs only inside system-Python owned worker/session. Helper command errors remain recorded; parent controls that process group and retains original serial lock until actual child wait and group drain.
Launcher v3 writes result.json, then rechecks allocated file bytes before printing a successful result reference. An over-cap saved result is retained failed evidence, not accepted completion.

reviewed_behavior.minimum_inventory_integration: /usr/bin/python3 -B -s worker dispatches inventory before prepare_source_inputs or native authority; runs frozen inventory_finish_v2 with exact guard and bounded journal. Native/environment payload preparation is not a prerequisite to this inventory branch.
reviewed_behavior.parent_child_binding: Exact parent-owned admission, child live argv/PID/start/ppid and pipe ACK; original lock proof remains unchanged. Child command descendants inherit the new worker process group.
reviewed_behavior.cleanup: Normal and exceptional paths wait and verify group empty before release. Repeated cleanup failure retains lock and records cleanup-pending; reused leader is not signaled. Python cleanup does not guarantee handling SIGKILL/OOM; root actual post-exit physical checks remain necessary.
reviewed_behavior.error_evidence: Worker helper cleanup errors and durable journal prefix retained; parent records its own failure and observed child exit. Partial artifacts do not imply stage success or external launcher exit.
reviewed_behavior.journal: 64 KiB raw blocks, 256 MiB raw/64 MiB gzip bounds, per-event flush/fsync, full raw/compressed hashes and roundtrip. Failed event is not promoted to durable count.
reviewed_behavior.output_chain: Parent result -> worker result -> inventory/result.json and exported files; events retained beside them. No automatic successor launch.
reviewed_behavior.budget: Inventory AS 2 GiB and CPU 600 s are per process; wall 900 s, CPU 5/nice19, 128 MiB allocated FILE bytes including final result, 8 MiB log, 64 MiB single file, original root/NVMe 28/30 GiB floors. Directory blocks are not summed; aggregate theoretical helper/journal/log maxima can fail the total cap.
reviewed_behavior.source_authority_boundary: Default external_authorities=None leaves missing source authority explicit. Supplied source_evidence bytes and meaning remain an independent root review precondition, not authenticated by formatting checks.
